title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel convinces Saravanan to attend the bangle ceremony for his baby's sake. Later, Bhagyam breaks down in tears when Muthusudar sends photos of Thangamayil.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha's prayers turn Pandian spiritual, shocking Nila. When Sembaruthi visits the couple, Nadesan rides her home, and Pandian reveals that she is Nadesan's ex-girlfriend.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya plans to send Nachiyar to an old-age home with Parvathy's help. Elsewhere, Ragu attracts Muthu's customers with tempting offers, putting his business at risk.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu grows increasingly fond of Arjun after he returns the pearl chain she lost during the struggle. Meanwhile, Karthik angrily confronts Sethupathi for troubling Kasthuri.
